mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, password, salt, name, email, terms_agreed_at, privacy_agreed ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{password}, #{salt}, #{name}, #{email}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{privacyAgreed} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, password, salt, name, email FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id, name, gender, bmi, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
